run.question:
Alertmanager alert CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-16T22:44:54Z.
Alert expression (PromQL): label_replace(label_replace((sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))) / (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m]))), "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)") > 0.5
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is confirmed by the alerting metric: at 2026-11-16T22:44:54Z checkout server spans for span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder had ERROR rate ~0.033/s while the STATUS_CODE_UNSET series for the same span fell to 0, i.e. essentially all PlaceOrder server spans in the last minutes ended in error. The error signal is new: the STATUS_CODE_ERROR counter for that span/host first appears at 22:41:54Z with value 0, then 5 at 22:42:54Z and 8 at 22:44:54Z; before that it did not exist, so the deviation began around 22:41Z, roughly 3 minutes before the alert fired. The failure is localized to one downstream call: within checkout's own span inventory the only other ERROR series over the last 60 minutes is the client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (same 9.90 increase as PlaceOrder server errors), while cart, currency, shipping and product-catalog calls in the same failing traces returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0. Payment is the origin of the failure text: its own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries ERROR with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', raised inside payment's own handler (stack trace at module.exports.charge /usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13), and its Charge success counter froze at 45 from about 22:40:54Z onward while errors accumulated, so every Charge after that point failed. However payment itself was not changed: deployment payment generation stayed at 1, its single pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 (uid d2ca1d0e) started around 05:59Z on 2026-11-16 and is present unchanged through the window, with image digest sha256:33f327b3... The only Kubernetes change observed in namespace otel-demo during the hour is checkout: deployment checkout generation went 4 -> 5 between 22:31:54Z and 22:32:54Z (matching the operator-reported rollout at 22:32:04Z), a new pod checkout-6984fc74d9-jh5kd started at 22:32:04Z, and the new pod uses the same image digest sha256:5ab0d7b9... as the replaced pod checkout-d9bf44475-ts8c6 — i.e. a configuration-only change. Every other otel-demo deployment, including payment and load-generator, shows zero generation changes. Impact observed: checkout (its own PlaceOrder server spans), payment (its own Charge server spans), and the request path above them — frontend (POST, POST /api/checkout, executing api route 500s), frontend-proxy (ingress / router frontend egress 500s) and load-generator (POST 500s). Low-rate ad/flagd/recommendation error spans did not deviate with this incident. The most likely cause is the checkout configuration-only rollout, which now produces a token that payment rejects — but that link rests on timing plus the absence of any other change, and it is weakened by a ~10 minute gap between the new checkout pod start (22:32:04Z) and the first observed error (~22:41:54Z); no evidence shows the request payload or the changed configuration value.

claims.text: The alerting metric reproduces at 2026-11-16T22:44:54Z: checkout server spans with span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder show rate ~0.0331/s with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR while the same span/host's STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate is 0, so the 5-minute PlaceOrder error ratio is effectively 100% in the last points.

The checkout PlaceOrder error counter is new: the STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is 0 at 22:41:54Z, 5 at 22:42:54Z, 6 at 22:43:54Z and 8 at 22:44:54Z, and no earlier sample of that series exists in the queried hour, so the deviation started around 22:41-22:42Z.

Within service_name=checkout the only two ERROR series over the last 60 minutes are SPAN_KIND_SERVER oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and SPAN_KIND_CLIENT oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, both with increase 9.90; no other checkout operation (cart, currency, shipping, product-catalog, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart) recorded errors in that window.

In the failing checkout traces, the failing child call is oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (status_tags error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=2) while oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans in the same traces report rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

Payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge in service_name=payment records ERROR with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and a stack trace raised in payment's own handler (module.exports.charge, /usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13); its parent_references point to checkout's Charge client span (e.g. parent spanID 876fe67a03f266ce, trace c1bb53572a5f79ddb7a9f96b1d5ae894).

Payment's Charge success counter for status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET stopped increasing at 45 during the 22:39:54Z-22:40:54Z interval and stayed 45 through 22:44:54Z, while its STATUS_CODE_ERROR counter went 0 (22:41:54Z) -> 5 -> 6 -> 8, i.e. no Charge call succeeded during the last ~4 minutes.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout metadata generation rose from 4 to 5 between the 22:31:54Z and 22:32:54Z samples and stayed 5, while Deployment otel-demo/payment generation stayed at 1 for the whole hour.

Pod checkout-6984fc74d9-jh5kd has kube_pod_start_time 1794868324 (2026-11-16T22:32:04Z) and the replaced pod checkout-d9bf44475-ts8c6 had start time 1794823363 (~10:02:43Z); pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 has start time 1794808752 (~05:59:12Z) and that single value persists across the window, so payment did not restart during the incident.

The new checkout pod's container reports the same image digest as the replaced pod (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635, image tag 2.0.2-checkout), and the payment container keeps image digest sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87 throughout.

checkout now runs under ReplicaSet checkout-6984fc74d9 (new series, present from 22:34:54Z) owned by Deployment checkout, and payment runs under the single ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6 owned by Deployment payment.

Across all 21 otel-demo deployments, only checkout had a kube_deployment_metadata_generation change in the last 60 minutes (changes=1); payment, load-generator, frontend, flagd and all others returned changes=0.
ERROR span increases over 60 minutes by service are: frontend 29.71, checkout 19.81, frontend-proxy 19.40, load-generator 16.41, payment 9.90, ad 2.08, flagd 2.08, recommendation 2.08.

The user-facing path errors carry the same payment message: frontend spans POST, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and POST /api/checkout returned 500, frontend-proxy ingress and 'router frontend egress' returned 500, and load-generator POST spans returned 500 with '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'.

The low-volume ad/flagd/recommendation error spans are not aligned with this incident: their 5-minute error rates are ~0.004/s at 22:29:54Z, 0 at 22:34:54Z and 22:39:54Z, recommendation ~0.004/s at 22:44:54Z... at 22:44:54Z all three return 0, while the checkout/payment deviation began ~22:41Z.

Checked and healthy in the failing traces: shipping (oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote, POST returning 200), currency (Currency/Convert with otel.status_code=OK), cart (GetCart/HGET with rpc.grpc.status_code=0) and product-catalog (GetProduct with rpc.grpc.status_code=0), and quote (POST /getquote, calculate-quote) show no error status.

The configuration-only rollout of Deployment otel-demo/checkout at 2026-11-16T22:32:04Z (generation 4 -> 5, new pod checkout-6984fc74d9-jh5kd, unchanged image digest) introduced a change in what checkout sends to PaymentService/Charge, so payment's charge handler now rejects the request as 'Invalid token' and PlaceOrder fails; this is supported only by the change being the sole observed change in the namespace and upstream of the failing call.

An alternative candidate that remains open: the token rejection originates in payment-side state that changed without a pod restart (for example a feature-flag/validation state served by flagd, or a Secret/config consumed at request time). Payment's deployment generation and pod identity did not change, so this cannot be excluded from the metrics alone; no evidence in this Run shows flag or secret content.

Simple timing causation is not established: the new checkout pod started at 2026-11-16T22:32:04Z but the first checkout PlaceOrder error sample appears only at 22:41:54Z (counter 0 at 22:41:54Z, 5 at 22:42:54Z), a gap of about 10 minutes during which PlaceOrder and Charge were still succeeding.

Payment was not restarted or re-deployed during the incident window: its container image digest is constant, its pod uid/start time (~05:59:12Z) is unchanged, and its deployment generation stayed 1, so a payment rollout is not the explanation.

Checkout's other dependencies were considered as the cause and rejected: cart, currency, shipping, product-catalog and quote all returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 / HTTP 200 in the same failing traces, and none of those deployments changed generation during the hour, so failures in them are not the source of the PlaceOrder errors.

A latency/throughput degradation was considered and rejected: the failing Charge server spans are sub-millisecond to ~2ms (duration 890-2243us for checkout's client span, 890-1002us for payment's server span) and the failure is an explicit application error message, not a timeout.

gaps: change_history and kubernetes_state integrations are not integrated in this Run, so the content of the checkout change at 22:32:04Z (ConfigMap/Secret/env diff, release rel-20261116223203) is unknown; only its existence, timing and unchanged image digest are observed.
The charge request payload (the token/card fields checkout sends) is not visible in the supplied telemetry, so the reason payment classifies the token as invalid is unknown.
pod_logs is not integrated, so payment's per-request logs around 22:41:54Z-22:44:54Z were not examined.
The ~10 minute offset between the new checkout pod start (22:32:04Z) and the first observed error (~22:41:54Z) is unexplained by the available evidence.
Whether the new checkout pod was Ready and receiving traffic between 22:32:04Z and 22:41:54Z was not verified (kube_pod_status_ready not queried).

This is a sampled trace view: the spans shown describe the traces returned, not a complete call graph or a failure rate for all requests; spans omitted by the adapter and traces not returned remain unknown.
next_steps: Review the checkout Deployment diff for release rel-20261116223203 (env vars and mounted ConfigMaps/Secrets related to the payment/charge request) against the previous revision checkout-d9bf44475.
Compare a failing Charge request payload captured after 22:41:54Z with one captured before 22:32:04Z to identify the field payment now rejects as an invalid token.
Check payment's flagd flag values and any Secret/config it reads for token validation around 22:41Z, since payment itself was not restarted.

If the configuration change is not confirmed as benign, consider reverting Deployment otel-demo/checkout to the prior revision and re-measuring the PlaceOrder error ratio (advisory only; no changes were executed in this Run).
